name: Berggasthof Wastler
beschreibung:
Berggasthof Wastler is situated in Thiersee, a valley village located in the Kufstein district of Tyrol. The inn is peacefully located at the entrance to the valley and is easily accessible both by car and on foot.

The kitchen serves delicious regional Tyrolean specialties and traditional home-style dishes. Guests can choose between relaxing in the welcoming taproom parlor or enjoying the fresh air in the small guest garden. The establishment is perfectly suited for day-trippers and hikers eager to discover the surrounding mountain landscapes.
